guides.title: Bow Drill Fire Starting
guides.excerpt: Start a fire using friction with a bow drill spindle and fireboard. A primitive but effective method when no modern tools are available.

guides.title: Flint and Steel
guides.excerpt: Create sparks using flint and steel to ignite tinder. Reliable technique that works in any weather condition.

guides.title: Fire Plow
guides.excerpt: Create fire by rubbing a hardwood stick in a groove of a softer wood board. One of the oldest fire-making methods.

guides.title: Fire Tinder
guides.excerpt: Learn which materials make the best tinder for starting fires. The foundation of every successful fire.

guides.title: Fire Lay
guides.excerpt: Arrange your firewood for optimal burning. Different fire lays for different purposes - cooking, warmth, signals.

guides.title: Water-Proof Fire
guides.excerpt: Start and maintain a fire in wet conditions. Techniques for rain, snow, and damp environments.

guides.title: Water Filtration
guides.excerpt: Filter dirty water through layers of sand, charcoal, and gravel to remove sediment and improve clarity.

guides.title: Boiling Water
guides.excerpt: Boil water for at least 1 minute to kill pathogens. The most reliable method of water purification in the wild.

guides.title: Water Collection
guides.excerpt: Collect water from rain, dew, rivers, and natural springs. Learn various techniques to source water in the wilderness.

guides.title: Solar Disinfection (SODIS)
guides.excerpt: Use sunlight to purify water. Simple, effective method that requires no fuel.

guides.title: Improvised Water Filters
guides.excerpt: Make effective water filters from natural or available materials when you have no commercial filter.

guides.title: Treating Fractures
guides.excerpt: Improvise splints and slings to stabilize broken bones when professional medical help is unavailable.

guides.title: Controlling Bleeding
guides.excerpt: Stop severe bleeding using direct pressure, elevation, and improvised tourniquets. Critical emergency skills.

guides.title: Treating Shock
guides.excerpt: Recognize and treat shock. Keep the victim warm, elevate legs, and maintain body temperature until help arrives.

guides.title: Treating Burns
guides.excerpt: Properly treat thermal burns, including cooling, covering, and recognizing when professional care is needed.

guides.title: CPR
guides.excerpt: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation. Life-saving technique when someone stops breathing or has no heartbeat.

guides.title: Choking
guides.excerpt: How to help someone who is choking. The Heimlich maneuver and other techniques to clear airway.

guides.title: Snake Bites
guides.excerpt: Respond to snake bites. What to do - and what NOT to do - when bitten by a venomous snake.

guides.title: Hypothermia
guides.excerpt: Recognize and treat hypothermia. Life-threatening cold emergency that requires immediate action.

guides.title: Heat Stroke
guides.excerpt: Recognize and treat heat stroke. Life-threatening emergency that occurs when body overheats.

guides.title: Debris Hut
guides.excerpt: Build an insulated debris hut using only natural materials. Excellent for cold weather survival shelter.

guides.title: Snow Cave
guides.excerpt: Construct an insulated shelter from snow. Snow is an excellent insulator and can provide life-saving warmth.

guides.title: Lean-to Shelter
guides.excerpt: Build a simple lean-to shelter using logs and branches. Quick to construct and provides good protection.

guides.title: Tropical Shelter
guides.excerpt: Build shelter in hot, humid environments. Focus on rain and insect protection rather than warmth.

guides.title: A-Frame Shelter
guides.excerpt: Build a simple A-frame shelter. Quick to construct, sturdy, and provides good protection from elements.

guides.title: Navigation by Sun
guides.excerpt: Find direction using the sun, shadow stick method, and watch method. Reliable navigation without any tools.

guides.title: Navigation by Stars
guides.excerpt: Use the North Star and other constellations to find direction at night. Essential night navigation skill.

guides.title: Following Water
guides.excerpt: Use rivers and streams to find civilization. Water flows downhill and often leads to populated areas.

guides.title: Making a Compass
guides.excerpt: Create an improvised compass using a needle, magnet, and floating material. Find direction without a proper compass.

guides.title: Cloud Reading
guides.excerpt: Use clouds to predict weather and find direction. Learn what different cloud types tell you about coming conditions.

guides.title: Basic Foraging
guides.excerpt: Identify edible plants, berries, and mushrooms. Learn which wild foods are safe to eat and how to prepare them.

guides.title: Simple Traps
guides.excerpt: Build basic snares and traps to catch small game. Essential skills for procuring meat in survival situations.

guides.title: Improvised Fishing
guides.excerpt: Catch fish with minimal equipment. Simple fishing methods and traps that work in survival situations.

guides.title: Cooking Without a Pot
guides.excerpt: Cook food without traditional cookware. Improvised methods using hot rocks, coals, and spit roasting.

guides.title: Fire Signals
guides.excerpt: Create signal fires to attract rescue. Use smoke, light, and specific patterns to maximize visibility.

guides.title: Signal Mirror
guides.excerpt: Use a mirror or reflective surface to signal aircraft and distant rescuers. Can be seen for miles.

guides.title: Whistle Signals
guides.excerpt: Use a whistle for communication and distress signals. Three blasts is the universal distress signal.

guides.title: Alarm Siren Signals
guides.excerpt: Understand what different alarm siren patterns mean. International maritime, civil defense, and country-specific emergency signals.

guides.title: Ground-to-Air Signals
guides.excerpt: Create large visual signals visible from aircraft. Universal ground signals for rescue.

guides.title: Storm Warning Signs
guides.excerpt: Recognize weather changes before storms arrive. Cloud signs, pressure changes, and animal behavior.

guides.title: Emergency Kit Checklist
guides.excerpt: Essential items for survival and emergency preparedness. What to have in your kit and bug out bag.
